constraints: Nothing leaves the system before human approval.
goal: Send the team a short weekly summary by 5 PM today
risks: Summary states more than the notes support.
Message sent to the wrong list.

steps.action: Read the week's notes and list what happened.
steps.why: The summary must trace to the notes.

steps.action: Summarise the notes into a short draft under 300 words.
failure_points: A nuance is flattened into a false claim

steps.action: Confirm the recipient list and the exact message before sending.
steps.why: Sending is irreversible — the human must see the text first.

steps.action: Send the approved summary to the team list.
steps.why: Delivery is the goal; the receipt proves it went out as approved.
